_comment: Maps top-level SLSsteam config.yaml keys that have empty defaults (key:) to their structural type.
_comment2: Only needs updating when the SLSsteam dev adds a brand-new key with no default value.

_types.scalar: A single value (yes/no, number, or string)
_types.map: A mapping of `  key: value` entries
_types.map_of_lists: A mapping whose values are sub-lists
